fusions.name: Raking Pounce
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then rakes it with a hand-held arrow that deals 13 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Before They Hear
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Each arrow has 25% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Twisting Landing
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds and puts you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Soft-Footed Stalk
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
